title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER | DATA ENGINEER
summary: Software engineer with practical experience building backend services, data pipelines, and data-backed applications. Project work includes relational database architecture, ETL ingestion pipelines, TF-IDF semantic search, Cloudflare serverless edge infrastructure (D1, KV, R2), RESTful microservices, third-party API integrations, and workflow automation. Brings strong Python, Java, SQL, and TypeScript foundations alongside test-driven development (TDD), code review, and collaborative delivery. Targeting entry-level software and data engineering roles where backend engineering skills can support reliable data services.

Backend, Web & APIs: Third-Party API Integration (MTN MoMo, Google Calendar)

bullets: Facilitate hands-on sessions covering Python fundamentals, Java object-oriented design, and Git workflows for incoming cohorts.
Conduct code reviews, help troubleshoot systems, and reinforce test-driven development (TDD) and maintainable coding practices.

projects.name: Automated Job Pipeline & Tailored PDF Resume Engine
bullets: Engineered an automated lead pipeline scraping public job feeds using Python, BeautifulSoup, and backoff retry handling.
Implemented TF-IDF cosine similarity scoring to match candidate profiles against incoming job descriptions.
Built a Jinja2 & xhtml2pdf rendering engine to automatically generate job-tailored PDF CVs and managed workflow tracking via a Streamlit dashboard and SQLite.

projects.name: MoCredit - AI Credit Scoring & Micro-Lending Mini App
bullets: Worked on a fintech application using a Node.js/Hono backend on Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 for persistent storage, and Cloudflare KV for score caching.
Integrated MTN MoMo Collections (RequestToPay) and Disbursements APIs, with an n8n-orchestrated AI coaching workflow.

projects.name: Thuso Health - Digital Health Passport & Smart Clinic Finder
bullets: Co-built an offline-first health passport and clinic finder with backend APIs using Hono/Cloudflare Workers, D1 records, R2 medical attachments, and JWT authentication.
Developed data-informed clinic recommendations using travel-time, queue-congestion, and load-shedding/solar-power information; supported offline caching and sync-on-reconnect.

projects.name: TSUMO Network - Backend Data Architecture
bullets: Co-engineered Python-based REST API endpoints handling media-streaming metadata workflows and user request routes.
Implemented server-side business logic to automate complex, usage-based revenue allocation and payout calculations.
Integrated application layers with persistent relational database storage to ensure safe, validated transaction logging.

projects.name: Code Clinic Booking System
bullets: Built a booking application for scheduling and managing academic code clinic sessions using Python, Flask, SQLite, and Google Calendar API integrations.

projects.name: Robot World Simulation Platform
bullets: Built a Java multiplayer client-server simulation using Maven, object-oriented design, test-driven development, Swing, and socket/network programming; refactored code in response to complexity warnings.
